_template._comment: Template for data-etl/config.json. Keys beginning with '_' are documentation helpers; remove them for a minimal runtime config.
_template._usage: Set CONFIG_PATH to this file and optionally KG_APP_ID. Relative knowledge-graph paths are resolved from the data-etl project root.
_template._safety: clear_neo4j_before_run defaults to false. Prefer replace_existing_document=true for per-document refreshes.

cardiology_protocols._comment: Application id. KG_APP_ID defaults to cardiology_protocols.

indexing._comment: Classic vector index settings, separate from the Neo4j Section vector index.
indexing.name: all_mini_cardiology_protocols
indexing.description: Documents containing medical protocols for cardiologic patients.

embeddings._comment: Embedding model used by the classic ETL path.

preprocessing._comment: PDF/Markdown preprocessing and classic chunking settings.

knowledge_graph._comment: Settings consumed by src/main_graph.py and src/knowledge_graph/build_graph.py.

_fields.phase: One of preprocess, graph, entities, embeddings, normalization, umls_connections, full.
_fields.work_root: Root for TOC, Markdown, anchors, chunks, Section views, acronyms, logs, and reviews.
_fields.mineru_markdown_root: MinerU Markdown root. Use null for work_root/mddocs.
_fields.clear_neo4j_before_run: Global destructive delete. Keep false; per-document replacement is configured under graph_loader.

_fields.chat_provider: Chat backend used for entity extraction.
_fields.embedding_provider: Backend used for Neo4j Section embeddings.
_fields.local_files_only: Disable remote model downloads for local Hugging Face runs.

_fields.embedding_dimensions: Optional shortened output dimension when supported.

text_cleaning._comment: Explicit text-cleaning policy for retrieval Section views. When present, config values are authoritative; environment variables remain a fallback for legacy callers.

retrieval_view._comment: Mandatory derived Section view consumed by the graph loader. Canonical hierarchical chunks remain immutable.

_fields.max_level: null keeps every active canonical Section; an integer N absorbs deeper Sections into their nearest level-N owner.
_fields.include_descendant_titles: Include descendant titles in aggregated text.
_fields.include_section_ids_in_titles: Prefix included descendant titles with their section ids.
_fields.force: Rebuild the derived Section view even when validated cache metadata matches.

_fields.min_text_chars_to_embed: Minimum active Section text length marked embed=true.
_fields.replace_existing_document: Replace only the document currently being loaded. Safe alternative to global deletion.

_fields.max_sections: Limit eligible retrieval Sections; null means all.
_fields.max_batch_chars: Maximum characters in a normal multi-Section chat request.
_fields.emergency_max_single_chars: Maximum characters per deterministic LLM segment for an oversized Section. Content is segmented, never truncated.
_fields.skip_processed: Skip retrieval Sections already marked entity_extracted.
_fields.replace_section_mentions: Replace stale MENTIONS for each processed retrieval Section.
_fields.use_acronym_validation: Use per-document acronym caches during deterministic validation.
_fields.clear_previous_review: Clear prior review exports for processed documents.
_fields.include_source_preview_in_review: Include source previews in review artifacts.

entity_normalization._comment: Optional UMLS normalization of existing Concept nodes.

umls_connections._comment: Optional UMLS/SNOMED relation discovery; defaults to export-only.

section_embeddings._comment: Only active retrieval Sections with embed=true are processed.

_fields.max_sections: Limit eligible retrieval Sections; null means all.
_fields.max_chars_per_section: Backward-compatible name: maximum characters per embedding segment. Long Sections are fully segmented and pooled with a length-weighted mean; they are not truncated.
_fields.allow_title_only: Allow a Section embedding when no body text is available.
